note: O'Brien County Conservation park on a 21-acre former gravel pit 2 miles west of Sanborn, with a 10-acre fishing pond, fishing jetty, swim beach, boat ramp, playground and resident host. Sites sit on a wooded loop north of the beach and parking area. --Claude
summary: Fees $20 -> $28 (county's own page and the mycountyparks booking header; the mycountyparks body text still says $20). Confirmed 14 sites (1-6 seasonal, 7-13 online), 20/30/50A full hookups, showers, dump, Wi-Fi, May 1 - Oct 15. Pond is ~10 acres (lake-sized, not a pond under the 5-acre line). Waterfront lead: lakeview -> not waterfront. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade lead): stored lakeview -> not waterfront. The county map puts sites 1-13 on two rows of the campground loop; the south row (7-13) faces its own loop road, then the playground, shelter, parking lot and swim beach before the pond, and NAIP shows a band of trees across most of that ground. The official campground photo (Douma-campground-E-view-2024) shows the loop under trees with no water in view; the only water photo is taken from the fishing jetty. Water size: the county gives a 10-acre pond, and NAIP measures roughly 4-4.5 ha across its two connected basins, so it is over the ~5-acre line and could carry a view, but no source shows one from a site.

FEES: $20 -> $28. obriencountyparks.org says '$28.00/night', and the mycountyparks booking pages head '$28 /Night'; the mycountyparks body text ('$20.00 Per Night plus $4 fee', 'Camping Fee is $20.00 Per Night') is stale. Whether the $4 processing fee still applies on top of the $28 is unclear; I kept it as the reservation fee.
SITES: the park page says 14 sites and mycountyparks lists Douma Campsite #01-#14, but the county map shows 13 numbered pads and '13 full hook up sites'. Count kept at 14.

PHONE: none stored. The county's number, 712-295-7200 (O'Brien County Conservation, Peterson), is on the park page and map. Website: the county's own page https://obriencountyparks.org/our-parks/douma-park/ is the better website; the stored mycountyparks link works as the booking url.
